name: github_list_repos
description: List the repos in the connected GitHub account, which one is open in the code panel, and which one is linked to the open project. Call it before opening a repo by name.

name: github_open_repo
description: Open a repo in the code panel. Returns its top folder so you can say what is in it.

repo.description: repo id (owner/name) or just the repo name

name: github_open_file
description: Open a file from the open repo in the code panel. Read-only. For the bundled sample project use code_open_file instead.

path.description: file path in the repo, e.g. src/main.py

name: github_list_prs
description: Show the open repo's open pull requests in the code panel and return them (number, title, author, branches).

name: github_show_pr
description: Show one pull request in the code panel: its summary, with the changed files on the left to open as diffs. Returns its title, description and changed files so you can walk the user through it. You can only show pull requests; you cannot merge, approve or push.

name: github_close_pr
description: Leave the pull request view and go back to the repo's files.

name: github_link_repo
description: Link a repo to the open project, so the code panel opens that repo whenever this project is open. Use it when the user says a repo belongs to this project.

repo.description: repo id (owner/name) or name; leave out to link the repo that is open now
